statement: Express $3\cos\theta+4\sin\theta$ in the form $R\cos(\theta-\alpha)$ with $R>0$, and state its maximum value.
solution: $R=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5$ and $\alpha=\arctan(\tfrac43)$. Hence $3\cos\theta+4\sin\theta=5\cos(\theta-\alpha)$, whose maximum value is $5$.
